newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE MEETS ON KAIJA, RIGA SHIPYARD.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE MEETS ON KAIJA, RIGA SHIPYARD.

text.p: Riga stock exchange said on Friday that its board meeting today will decide on whether Kaija fish cannery will join the official list and about when Riga Shipyard will join the stock exchange.

"Our board meeting, expected to be concluded by 1100, is now deciding on Kaija fish cannery's transfer to the official list and also about Riga Shipyard joining either of the two lists," a bourse spokesman told Reuters.
Kaija, which has been eyeing the official list since late last year, earlier this week submitted its audited 1996 and first quarter 1997 results to the bourse.
Riga Shipyard has also applied for the official list but the stock exchange said it wanted to make sure the company would be consistent in providing information on its activities.
A decision on Riga Shipyard would depend on the timely submission of 1996 figures, the bourse has said.
